Market today:
The Fed just hiked rates, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield to 5%. This is a tough environment for your tech/chip names, which thrive on lower rates and growth expectations. The market mood is cautious, driven by tightening monetary policy.

Your holdings:
SOXL is down a brutal -59.15% and SPAL is down -31.41%. Both are leveraged ETFs and decaying, amplifying your losses. QQQ and SMH are also in the red and on "TRIM" status. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. Any further climb will pressure your tech-heavy book. Also, watch for any follow-through on Trump's comments regarding Fed independence.

Bottom line:
The macro environment is turning against your concentrated tech/chip book; managing risk is paramount.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL. Its -59.15% loss on a leveraged, decaying ETF is a major drag, especially on margin.
SPY: Your SPY position is on "SELL" status. Respect the 705 stop to protect your 2.68% gain.
SQQQ: Given the Fed hike and rising yields, consider a small hedge with SQQQ. Scanner entry 39.90-39.84, stop 39.30.
